newsitem.title: CHINA: Lianhua posts slight 1996 net profit.
newsitem.headline: Lianhua posts slight 1996 net profit.

text.p: Shanghai Lianhua Fibre Co said on Friday its net profit was only 28,500 yuan for 1996, down from 9.508 million yuan in 1995, based on international accounting standards.
Based on domestic accounting standards, the 1996 net was 899,700 yuan against 20.806 million yuan in 1995, the company said in its 1996 annual report published in the Shanghai Securities News.

"Since the second half of 1995, China's chemical fibre industry has been hit sharply by changes in the market," the report said. "Prices of chemical fibre products have been falling sharply with firms in the industry making little or no profit."
In the first half of 1996, the company registered a loss of 6.3787 milllion yuan, it said.
The company managed to return to profitability for 1996 only after efforts to improve its management along with a recovery in the chemical fibre market that began in August, the report said.

The company's board of directors have proposed no cash dividend or bonus share issue from 1996 earnings, pending approval at a shareholders meeting scheduled for June 25, it said. The company gave no forecast for 1997 results.
